name: Cityscapes
description: A large-scale dataset of urban street scenes from 50 cities, with pixel-level, instance-level, and vehicle-level annotations for semantic urban scene understanding. This record does not distribute dataset files.
citation: Cordts, M., Omran, M., Ramos, S., Rehfeld, T., Enzweiler, M., Benenson, R., Franke, U., Roth, S., & Schiele, B. (2016). The Cityscapes Dataset for Semantic Urban Scene Understanding. Proceedings of the IEEE Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR), 3213–3223. https://doi.org/10.1109/CVPR.2016.350
